sources.title: Introducing the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model
sources.evidence: October 7, 2025 public-preview announcement: specialized Gemini 2.5 Pro-derived model, visual reasoning, UI function calls and client-side execution; primarily browser optimized.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Published October 7, 2025; explicitly identifies Gemini 2.5 Pro (06-2025) as the base, including architecture, training data and implementation, with UI-control post-training. This named lineage could support nominal-size inheritance if the base had a supported count. The card supplies neither total nor active parameter counts. Text/screenshots in, proposed action function calls out; not optimized for desktop OS control.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Model Card, June 27, 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete June 27, 2025 card on October 27, 2026. The identified base is a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with token routing to a subset of experts. Neither its architecture section nor benchmark/safety comparisons gives a nominal total or activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 computer use model
sources.evidence: Exact API ID, image/text input, text output, 128,000 input and 64,000 output tokens. Current page explicitly states shutdown July 28, 2026; parent rechecked October 26, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact dated identifier is grouped under Gemini 2.5 Pro models; release October 7, 2025, shutdown July 28, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Hosted service terms, effective March 23, 2026, restrict extraction or replication of underlying model parameter weights; support proprietary service classification.

sources.title: Official Computer Use reference implementation: agent.py
sources.evidence: Lists the exact 2.5 identifier among legacy models; configures Computer Use and custom function declarations, with ThinkingConfig(include_thoughts=True). Client code executes returned actions.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 technical report, version 5
sources.evidence: Architecture section confirms sparse MoE Transformers; no numerical total or active count for the Computer Use variant or its Pro backbone was found. Does not independently specify this later specialized endpoint.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 inspection of the complete Gemini 3 Pro card, including architecture and comparisons with Gemini 2.5 Pro: no nominal total or active parameter count for the named 2.5 Pro base or Computer Use variant.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 inspection of the complete Gemini 3.1 Pro card and its predecessor comparisons: no numerical total or active parameter disclosure for Gemini 2.5 Pro or Computer Use.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 inspection of the decoded Argon card and its comparison material. Sparse MoE architecture and computer-use performance are described, but no numerical total or active parameter count for Gemini 2.5 Pro or Computer Use is given.

sources.title: Computer use, Gemini API
sources.evidence: Legacy 2.5 sections document UI actions and custom functions. Generic guide still lists the legacy model, conflicting with explicit shutdown notices on its dedicated model and deprecations pages.

sources.title: Models.dev original record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead was followed; its release, context, modality and capability claims were checked against first-party material.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 inspection of the full official technical report, including architecture, model comparisons and parameter-related passages. Sparse MoE routing is described, but Gemini 2.5 Pro has no published nominal total or active-parameter count here. Numbers for cited external models or benchmark tasks do not establish this base model size.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 inspection of the full later safety report, including Gemini 2.5 Pro references and comparison tables. No total or activated-parameter disclosure for the 2.5 Pro base or its Computer Use variant was found.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Additional Information
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 search located and reopened the complete five-page October 7, 2025 evaluation appendix. It describes Online-Mind2Web, WebVoyager and AndroidWorld environments, prompts and evaluation methods. Its parameter references concern sampling or function arguments, not model weights; no total or active model count is disclosed.

name.note: Official model name with documented preview designation.

developer.note: Google DeepMind model; Google is the catalog developer entity.

family.note: Explicit Pro-derived variant; Google also places this exact API ID under Gemini 2.5 Pro.

release_date.note: Earliest public preview announcement and exact-ID release table agree; not the earlier Mariner demonstrations.

open_weights.note: Distributed through the proprietary hosted API. Open reference agent code is not an open checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification for model access under Google service terms, not the website or example-code licenses.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-identifier, model-name and named-base searches on October 27, 2026, plus the original cards, complete technical report, evaluation appendix and later first-party comparisons, found no supported nominal total. The exact card explicitly identifies UI-control post-training of Gemini 2.5 Pro (06-2025), so nominal inheritance would be appropriate if that base had a documented count; no such count was found. Null reflects missing published numerical evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census or deployed-service attestation.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh active-parameter searches and later comparison-table checks found no numerical activated-parameter count for this variant or its explicitly named June 2025 Pro base. Sparse expert routing is established, but neither the number of active experts nor their parameter sizes is disclosed. No active count is inferred from total size, inference settings or another Gemini model.

architecture.note: Exact variant card explicitly inherits the June 2025 Pro architecture; that backbone is a sparse MoE Transformer. This is direct documented inheritance, not a name-based family assumption.

context_window.note: Exact endpoint input token limit; do not substitute the Pro backbone’s one-million-token limit or add output allowance.

modalities.note: Endpoint modalities; structured UI function calls are outputs, not image generation. Backbone audio/video support is not inherited here.

reasoning.note: Google describes visual reasoning and its reference client requests thought summaries for this model. This does not imply Gemini 3 thinking-level controls.

tool_call.note: Computer Use UI actions and custom functions are supported. The application executes them; this model is not a self-contained browser agent or a general guarantee of all built-in tools.

description.value: Specialized Gemini 2.5 model for browser-control agents that automate UI tasks
description.note: Accurate scope. The model proposes actions for an external agent loop; browser optimization does not establish desktop OS support.

patch.notes: Post-trained from Gemini 2.5 Pro (06-2025), a sparse MoE Transformer. Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed for both the variant and its named base. Browser UI actions require client-side execution. Google documents Gemini API shutdown on July 28, 2026; specifications describe the last documented model.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit on October 27, 2026 retains explicit null total and active counts. Checked exact-model and named-base searches, original Computer Use and June 2025 Pro cards, the full Gemini 2.5 technical report, the evaluation appendix, later Gemini 3 Pro/3.1 Pro/4 Argon cards and Gemini 4 safety comparisons. The named post-training lineage is sufficient for nominal inheritance in principle, but no supported count for its Pro base was found. The other 12 field assessments are preserved, including proprietary license, sparse MoE architecture, October 7, 2025 preview, 128k input and July 28, 2026 Gemini API shutdown.
